    from collections import Counter

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps = [(color, cells) for color, cells in _components(grid) if color != background]
    candidates = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        corner = _l_corner(cells)
        if corner is not None:
            candidates.append((len(cells), color, cells, corner))
    if not candidates:
        return out
    _, marker_color, marker, (cr, cc, sr, sc) = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])

    # The largest one-cell-thick L is the color key. Match identical objects
    # on opposite diagonal sides of its corner, then recolor the outside copy.
    by_shape = {}
    marker_set = set(marker)
    for color, cells in comps:
        if set(cells) == marker_set:
            continue
        inside = all((r-cr)*sr > 0 and (c-cc)*sc > 0 for r, c in cells)
        outside = all((r-cr)*sr < 0 and (c-cc)*sc < 0 for r, c in cells)
        if inside or outside:
            by_shape.setdefault(_shape(cells), [[], []])[0 if inside else 1].append(cells)
    for inside, outside in by_shape.values():
        if inside and outside:
            for cells in outside:
                for r, c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = marker_color
    return out
'''
